alt: The Maison Croyez waterless diffuser and a 100 ml scent bottle on a stone shelf. Leave the day at the door: one press, the whole room in about ten minutes. No water, no flame, your first scent is free, 30-day money back.
The Maison Croyez waterless scent diffuser. Scent for the whole room, no water, no flame. About 10 minutes to fill the room, up to 600 sq ft from one diffuser, one button with three strengths.

Not sure how it smells? Your first scent is free: one free 100 ml scent with every diffuser. Seven to choose from, each described by what it smells like and its three notes, for example Golden Blossom Harmony, like walking into a florist. Don’t love one? We swap it, free.
Made to be left on: no flame, no water, no heat, and a timer for 1, 3, 6 or 12 hours that stops on its own. A buyer says: I can go to sleep with it on in our bedroom and feel safe.
Candles and plug-ins next to Maison Croyez: no flame and it turns itself off, the whole room in ten minutes, 15+ days from every bottle, pour once and nothing to clean.
How to use it: pour in your 100 ml bottle, press once, exhale. Three strengths: subtle, balanced or full. A timer for 1, 3, 6 or 12 hours and a night light you can switch off.
One 100 ml bottle gives 15+ days of scent, under $2 an evening. Refills are your choice, we email you before every charge, and you can skip, swap or cancel any time.
The promise: love it in 30 days or every dollar back. Free shipping, a prepaid return label, a free scent swap and a lifetime warranty on the diffuser.

The Maison Croyez diffuser: 11.5 inches tall, 4 by 4 inches wide, 2.25 pounds. Guests ask what it is; most people think it is a speaker. A buyer says visitors always comment on how wonderful the house smells.
